name: Mailbox auditing settings
description: Shows whether mailbox auditing is off for the organisation, whether unified audit ingestion is on and, per mailbox, AuditEnabled, the audited actions, log age and audit bypass.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Mailboxes
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to check every mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: IncludeBypass
parameters.label: Check audit bypass
parameters.help: Check whether each mailbox's account bypasses auditing, which needs one extra read per mailbox.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: When no mailbox is named, stops after this many and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients and organisation configuration; reading unified audit ingestion may need an audit role.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.

With auditing on by default for the organisation, a mailbox can show AuditEnabled False and still be audited. Finding NoneFound is not proof that events are recorded; which events are recorded also depends on licence.
If unified audit ingestion cannot be read (for example without an audit role) it is Unknown on every row and the run says so.
Audit bypass needs one read per mailbox; unticked, AuditBypassEnabled is NotChecked.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
